title: Power Source Chooser
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Beginning electronics power-source selection
description: An interactive four-column infographic comparing USB adapters, 9 V batteries, AA packs, and LiPo pouch cells.

learningObjectives: Compare voltage, portability, current capability, charging, and safety when selecting a project power source.

keyQuestions: Why is a 9 V battery often poor for motors?
When does rechargeability justify added protection and charging circuitry?
commonMisconceptions: A higher battery voltage always means more useful power.
Any charger can safely charge a LiPo cell.
